opening.argument: The promotion offers a concrete ₹12 Paytm cashback reward while directing viewers into an external registration flow: “You will first have to click on the link,” then sign up for an application. The stated process connects registration with a promised credit “within a good hour,” presenting the reward as immediate and certain rather than qualified reporting or education. The displayed page instructs users to enter and submit a Paytm number and download and register on the Unacademy app, while the verification screen requires a mobile number for an OTP. This is a direct solicitation for a low-barrier reward that routes viewers through a third-party app and requests personal contact information.

citations.quote: You will first have to click on the link.
You have to sign up for this application after you have registered. You will see that within a good hour your Paytm Allot will be credited with 12 rupees.
